Online Loan Scams

By: Liz Fish | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
With 13 loan websites Damian Malander is making a killing. His website looks like they offering loans but infact they are not credit providers and instead they are passing you on to get loans and sometimes they don't even do that. What they are selling you is legal advice you didn't ask for like how to get a divorcee or fill out a will- anything but the loan you so desperately need. What you do get is even more debt than when you started. When you aply for the loan you have to click the terms and conditions to advance to the next page and in doing that deep in the small print you have agreed to have a stop order on your account for the next 12 months. THe first amont is R399 and then R99 for the next 11 months. If you try and call and cancel in the first 7 days you cant get through and they don't answer your emails. If you try an cancel they charge you a cancellation fee and you still end up paying about R800 for nothing. If you successfully stop the debit order then the court summons and threats of black listing arrive from Lifestyle Legal which is not a law firm or a registered debt collector. If you manage to stop one stop order they just change one digit and it slips past the next month and you are back at the bank asking for help. Some banks like Capitec just reverse it but others like Nedbank make you contact the company. Its nightmare that goes on for years.

Summary:
The court summons is for roughly R1770 and the threat is that you will have to pay legal costs over and above the initial amount. The summons doesn't have a number but people don't understand it has to be delivered by a sheriff of the court. Lifestyle Legal - the company that sends the threats of black listing and court summons are not even a legal firm or registered debt collectors.
The more sites you look to see what loans are out there the more stop orders you rack up.
The Stellenbosch law Clinic have taken on the case and are going to fight a class action to stop Damian Malander and similar loan scamsters. We have had loads of submissions on our website from desperate people. its a consumer story and a public interst story to expose this man. I have a PI who will track his number and movements to see that he is in the country and we will write a letter requesting a sit down interview and if that is not successful we will door stop him

Extra Budget Items:
The case studies are all in JHB and Pretoria and the scam atrist and the lawyers are in CT. I would like to fly up Monday evening- I will stay with family so no accommodation cost and fly back with derek to CT on Tuesday evening and he can return end of Wednesday so only one night accommodation cost for Derek On Tuesday evening.

Script:


Link: Times are tough, the economy is at an all-time low, unemployment is rife and South Africans are struggling. It can be difficult to get a loan so looking for help online seems to be the way to go, and there are so many sites you are spoilt for choice

Script: But do online websites mislead some consumers?

Hero Shot: Jaco Botes- Paramedic- 46 years old -Applied for R25 000 Loan Quest.

Jaco: I was recently divorced…. The ex-wife said she wanted me to buy out or return the vehicle to her . …..it was my only means of transport to get to work and home obviously so..being a blacklisted customer I didn't have a lot of avenues to go to

Ronald Esbach- Business Administrator- 51 years old - Applied for R12000 Loan Finder

Ronald “I used to work for a small company in Rivonia. … I was retrenched last year. I thought it was going to help me secure a loan and help me with my burdens but nothing came about

HERO SHOT: Sean Reid -Property rental agent- 48 years old - R20 000 Loan Hub
And Loan Finder

Sean Reid “Knowing that we were heading into December, it is a quiet patch. January is generally quiet. In real estate you on a commission basis. That is makes it a lot more difficult to get a loan. So online is the next option

Script: Although they applied on different sites they all connected to one company Lifestyle legal. The application looks the same as applying for a loan through the bank,and before submitting you have to to click the terms and conditions, and therein lies the small print

Link: “When you do a loan search these extremely sophisticated websites pop up with terms and conditions running to 14 pages they even quote they consumer protection act

Sean “you go online you fill in your details you read further down, you click and all of a sudden you have ordered a package, and that comes in an email. So I have now authorized to supply you with a package at this fee. There I stopped. So I thought by stopping and not responding to that email I have now killed the problem which obviously wasn't the case because straight after that I got another one saying they will be debiting my account with the initial fee which was R399 and they after it to be R99. There we sent an immediate email out again

Jaco “I came upon a company called loan quest which said Quick and easy loans and they actually stipulated for a black blacklisted customers as well. Did the online application under the impression I'm applying for a loan now.

Derek: so when did you get a big fright

Jaco: it was close to the end of the month. I suddenly noticed that there was a deduction of almost five hundred rand on my count which I didn't authorize. ….I was already looking for money. I wasn't looking to pay out any money.

Script: the next month they made another attempt

Derek: So they changed the number by one digit

Jaco: They literally just changed the number by one digit in order to have the debit order go through.

Script: When Ronald discovered he wasn’t getting a loan and had signed up for a service package he immediately tried to cancel.

Ronald “They give you a week in which to cancel the application which I tried to do. I even tried to phone them but the email address has come back as unfound and the phone just rings. There's no reply. Eventually a week goes by and they start with their debits

Script: NO-ONE WHO CONTACTED CARTE BLANCHE got a loan instead they had signed up for legal advice ranging from conveyancing to wills - a package they were locked into for a year. Then the SMS’s begin “You have 24hrs to settle and because they alleged you cancelled the package by reversing the stop order they add a bunch of penalties. The barrage is relentless and many people end up being blacklisted

Jaco: It wasn't even three weeks and the first email that I'm in breach of contract that I owe them. R1826.16 and that the threat was there immediately that if I don't pay them within 24 hours they're going to take punitive action

Sean “at least 3 times a week sometimes twice a day you get a letter from them saying would you like to be summoned would you like to be blacklisted please pay this amount .

Script: The letters of demand arrive from a company called Lifestyle Legal with a draft summons attached. It all looks very official and threatening, and most people are taken in but if you look carefully there is no number on the summons and it’s not signed. If you call in to find out what is going on they say you ticked the terms and conditions so there is nothing you can do. At this point that many people pay.

Stephan “ they are not legitimate these documents for a summons to be legitimate it has to be issued by the specific court so it'll have the details of the court as well as the case number. And it will be served through the sheriff's office “

Script: Stephan van der Merwe of the Stellenbosch Law Clinic says they are investigating a class action because 1000s of people have been hit since 2015.

Derek Are these sites unethical or illegal

Stephan “in our opinion both unethical from the point of view that it is simply... not morally justifiable the way that ... people are being.. clearly misled and it is also illegal it contravenes .. the Consumer Protection Act contravenes definitely sections in the electronic communication Transaction Act probably contravene sections of the Companies Act.

Script: These loans sites are registered to this man Damian Malander, 12 in total, they all appear to ceded their claims to Lifestyle legal, also registered under Malnader. So if you are not caught by one website you are likely to be referred to another. The letters of demand, draft summons and call centre, are all run by Lifestyle Legal and despite the name, it’s not a registered Law Firm

Derek: Sean what are they demanding now.

Sean: Well now they wanting the R1500 rand cancellation fee for the package that I ordered.

Derek: How much do you owe the bank at this stage

Sean " R5107 that is from October to now with reversals of debit orders, transaction fees administration fees because they are having to reverse amounts that arent getting paid, I couldn't have any money going into that account in the fear that loan hub could take it.

Link: “The National Consumer Commission has received more than 600 complaints regarding these loan sites since 2016 yet the saga has dragged on despite their investigation.

Script: Trevor Hattingh, spokesperson for the National Consumer Commission says they have been investigating MALANDER and associates for 3 years. HIS SITES ARE breaking many PARTS of the CONSUMER PROTECTION act but because they only have investigation powers and it’s the Consumer Tribunal that prosecutes they tried to resolve the problem directly.

Trevor “we have contacted their attorneys, their attorneys initially promised to have a sit down with us. We were then given the run around and told lets meet in in Cape Town...we were then informed at the last minute that no the client is no longer available and actually since 2016 they have not responded to any of our emails any of our requests. They only requested from us in our correspondence that we provide them with proof that there is an actual investigation and we have done that. And then all of a sudden they disappeared.

Script: Judging from Facebook and Hellopeter, thousand have been caught, we approached Malander for his side of the story

Derek” Link in airport” We have tried calling Mr malander a number of times we have sent SMS and emails we will have to try and meet him in Cape Town

Script: having still not heard from Mr Malander we hoped to catch him before he left for work

Up sound- Could we speak to Mr malander-he is not here he left earlier

Link at office “We have been told Mr Malander left the house in a bakkie with a college whether he is here at the office at Life Style house we are about to find out

Derek: “Now they can see us here we have been seen by 3 members of staff but we certainly are not made to feel welcome

Upsound at door and the secretary- We are looking for Mr malander, unfortunately he is not here today, do you know where he is?“ No I dont. Who would you say is the person under Mr Malander”- you can give us that- I dont want to answer any further questions. Can you speak to them and say look Carte Blanche is here they want an interview regarding all the complaints

Link leaving the lift:” It’s not easy to find anyone to speak to you can imagine what it is like for the clients”

Link: We have just heard that Damian Malander has returned to his home in Durbanville in a blue bakkie so the search continues and all we really want is to hear his side of the story

Upsound at door “Is Mr Malander here please, sorry he is not in where is he do you know I think he has gone out for buisness I don’t want to give you an interview”

Script: Eventually Malander declined an on-camera interview and replied in writing.
“ Our sites do not offer loans but a complimentary service of referring people to accredited loan providers. Our services and charges are clearly visible on every page of the websites. We deny people don’t get loans- but it is not our responsibility as we are simply a referral service.. We deny breaking any laws and are unaware of people not being able to cancel in the “cooling” off period

Script: The next step is for National Consumer Tribunal to lay charges against Lifestyle legal and all the subsidiary loan sites

Derek “Why is taken more than 4 years:

Trevor “ The legal processes unfortunately are not…. overnight process. We will have a substantial amount of evidence showing the tribunal that this conduct has been ongoing, ….basically there was total disregard for the law

Script: Malander says “We are unaware of any outstanding matters with the NCC

Script: But the constant harassment is wearing Ronald down, he has received over 20 draft court summons

Ronald “Two years later down the line they still sending demands

Stephan “our advice would be at this stage is simply to ignore those threats since they have no legal binding effect. And then secondly keep a very good written record of what exactly is transpiring.

Derek: Does it surprise you that these websites that these going on for so long.

Jaco: Derek it does. Yes its small amounts and I know ignorance is not an excuse but if you're desperate you will do anything to try to get yourself back on top. And I think this is how they caught us.

metadata.Unique Selling Point: With 13 loan websites Damian Malander is making a killing. His website looks like they offering loans but infact they are not credit providers and instead they are passing you on to get loans and sometimes they don't even do that. What they are selling you is legal advice you didn't ask for like how to get a divorcee or fill out a will- anything but the loan you so desperately need. What you do get is even more debt than when you started. When you aply for the loan you have to click the terms and conditions to advance to the next page and in doing that deep in the small print you have agreed to have a stop order on your account for the next 12 months. THe first amont is R399 and then R99 for the next 11 months. If you try and call and cancel in the first 7 days you cant get through and they don't answer your emails. If you try an cancel they charge you a cancellation fee and you still end up paying about R800 for nothing. If you successfully stop the debit order then the court summons and threats of black listing arrive from Lifestyle Legal which is not a law firm or a registered debt collector. If you manage to stop one stop order they just change one digit and it slips past the next month and you are back at the bank asking for help. Some banks like Capitec just reverse it but others like Nedbank make you contact the company. Its nightmare that goes on for years.
metadata.Summary: The court summons is for roughly R1770 and the threat is that you will have to pay legal costs over and above the initial amount. The summons doesn't have a number but people don't understand it has to be delivered by a sheriff of the court. Lifestyle Legal - the company that sends the threats of black listing and court summons are not even a legal firm or registered debt collectors. The more sites you look to see what loans are out there the more stop orders you rack up. The Stellenbosch law Clinic have taken on the case and are going to fight a class action to stop Damian Malander and similar loan scamsters. We have had loads of submissions on our website from desperate people. its a consumer story and a public interst story to expose this man. I have a PI who will track his number and movements to see that he is in the country and we will write a letter requesting a sit down interview and if that is not successful we will door stop him
